title: PNIO: fix return value of dissector
description:
Don't register dissectors that return TRUE or FALSE as as non-heuristic
dissectors; non-heuristic dissectors are supposed to return 0 if they
don't think the packet is for them and the number of bytes dissected if
they do.

Have the heuristic dissector return a bool; have the non-heuristic
dissector call the heuristic dissector and, if it returns true, return
the captured length of the dissector handed to it, otherwise return 0.
